briefing.headline: The soft landing holds as jobs stay firm and inflation eases closer to target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 has cooled and is nearing the Fed's target.
Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent for Oct 2026, giving the economy room to absorb that moderation.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury higher, from 4.88 percent to 4.98 percent.
